name: Riru
source:
Riru is a maid at Mr. [url=https://vndb.org/c61003]Maxim[/url]'s mansion that works alongside [url=https://vndb.org/c29769]Haresu[/url]. She is a gentle, reliable, kind, caring and modest person that values her virginity. Little does she know that her life is about to turn upside down once the Lieutenant [url=https://vndb.org/c29770]Prosper[/url]'s military unit comes to station themselves at her residence.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=17]MangaGamer[/url]]
